title: Koh Samui Villas for Large Groups: How to Plan Your Group Getaway
description: Planning a large group trip to Koh Samui? Find out which villa configurations work for 10-20+ guests, what to organise in advance, and how to get the best rates.

blocks.text: Koh Samui is an exceptional destination for large group travel — villa stays in particular offer the kind of shared communal experience that hotels simply cannot provide. Whether it’s a birthday celebration, a family reunion, a hen or stag party, or a group of friends travelling together, getting the logistics right from the start makes all the difference. Here’s how to plan a group villa trip to Koh Samui that everyone will talk about for years.
What Size is a “Large Group” for a Villa?
Most single villas comfortably accommodate up to 10-12 guests across 4-6 bedrooms. For groups of 14-30 people, the options are:

items: Multi-villa complex — several interconnected villas within one gated property, sharing a pool and common areas. Guests have individual privacy but shared social space.
Resort buyout — some boutique resorts offer full buyouts to groups. All rooms and facilities are exclusively yours.
Adjacent villa booking — two or three separate villas booked on the same street or within the same development. Less integrated but works for very large groups.

blocks.text: Choosing the Right Area for a Group
For large group stays, location considerations shift:

items: Proximity to activities — if your group wants easy access to water sports, nightlife, or day trip departure points, Bangrak/Choeng Mon or Chaweng are ideal. The Bangrak Pier in the north gives excellent ferry access to Ang Thong Marine Park.

Private and gated — for groups that want seclusion and quiet (family reunions, wellness groups), the hillside areas of Plai Laem offer gated villa complexes with sea views far from the tourist bustle.
Nightlife access — for groups who want to go out, Chaweng is the centre. Transport from Plai Laem or Choeng Mon to Chaweng takes 15-20 minutes by taxi.
Bedroom allocation — decide room assignments before arrival to avoid awkward on-arrival negotiations. Circulate a simple spreadsheet.
Catering approach — decide upfront whether you’ll cook in (private chef or self-catered), eat out together, or do a mix. A private chef for group dinners is dramatically cost-effective.
Shared costs — use a shared expense app (Splitwise, Tricount) from day one to track shared costs cleanly.

blocks.text: Group Activities That Work for 10+ People

items: Private boat charter — a full-day private speedboat or catamaran charter to Ang Thong Marine Park or the outer islands costs approximately 15,000-25,000 THB for a full day. Split between 12-15 people, this is highly affordable and the highlight of most group trips.
Thai cooking class — most schools in the Bangrak and Bophut area can accommodate groups up to 20. Half-day, hands-on, genuinely fun.
Muay Thai session — a group Muay Thai class is an energising way to start a day. Gyms near Bangrak and Chaweng offer group bookings.
Sunset cruise — a private catamaran sunset sail with canapés and drinks is one of the most memorable group experiences on the island. Departs from various piers including Bangrak.

blocks.text: What to Book Well in Advance
For peak season group trips, lead times are longer than individual bookings:

items: Villa: 6-12 months ahead for peak December-March
Cooking class for large group: 1-2 weeks

blocks.text: For a group of 10+, book a dedicated minibus and driver for the duration of the stay. A full-day minibus hire with driver costs approximately 2,000-3,000 THB — split between a group this is negligible. It eliminates the coordination headache of managing multiple Grab bookings every time you move.
